name: Mother's Milk
summary: Ragged John seeks a live sample of Mother's Milk, the poison of Mother Smolderweb. He wants you poisoned so he can draw the sample from your veins.

sections.title: Ragged John's Request
sections.body: In Blackrock Spire, Ragged John wants a sample of the poison called Mother's Milk. The Blackrock speak of its lethality, and the poison takes its name from Mother Smolderweb, the spider in Skitterweb cave. A gland alone will not satisfy him; he asks you to return while the poison flows through your veins.

sections.title: A Living Sample
sections.body: Mother Smolderweb is deep within Blackrock Spire. Ragged John asks you to let her poison you, then return to him while you are poisoned. He expects to draw the Milk from your veins himself.

faq.answer: Mother's Milk is a potent poison associated with Mother Smolderweb, the spider in Skitterweb cave.

faq.q: Who wants a sample of Mother's Milk?
faq.answer: Ragged John wants a live sample of Mother's Milk drawn from your veins.
Mother Smolderweb is in the heart of Blackrock Spire, in Skitterweb cave.

faq.q: Why won't Ragged John take the gland?
faq.answer: Ragged John asks for the poison flowing through your veins; he says a gland alone will not be enough.

faq.q: What does Ragged John want you to bring back?
faq.answer: He wants you to return while Mother Smolderweb's poison is in your veins.
